name: Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT)
description: Exploiting geospatial data from open sources for intelligence purposes. Covers satellite and street-level imagery analysis, geotagged content extraction, facility identification, physical security assessment from open imagery, and correlating geospatial data with other intelligence to support engagements.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to geospatial intelligence or open-source imagery analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the types of geospatial data available from open sources and their intelligence applications
evidence: Can describe common geospatial data sources (Google Earth, Sentinel, Mapillary)
Understands EXIF/geotag metadata and its intelligence value
Aware of basic geolocation concepts and coordinate systems

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic geospatial analysis using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Extracts and analyzes geotag metadata from images and files under guidance
Uses satellite imagery platforms to identify and document facilities
Performs basic geolocation of photos using visual landmarks

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts geospatial intelligence collection and analysis for engagements
evidence: Geolocates images and content using chronolocation and visual analysis across 3+ cases
Assesses physical security posture of facilities from open imagery
Correlates geospatial data with infrastructure and person OSINT to enrich assessments
Produces geospatial intelligence reports that pass QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex geospatial analysis; develops workflows; mentors analysts
evidence: Conducts temporal analysis using historical imagery to detect changes
Develops automated geospatial data collection and analysis workflows
Performs complex geolocation challenges requiring multi-source correlation
Reviews and mentors junior analysts on geospatial tradecraft

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines geospatial intelligence methodology; develops novel techniques; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's GEOINT methodology and toolchain
Develops novel geolocation or imagery analysis techniques
Publishes research on geospatial intelligence methods
Trains teams on GEOINT tradecraft and develops training scenarios

assessment_methods.description: Geolocate a set of images to within 1km accuracy using only open-source tools and imagery
Given a facility address, produce a physical security assessment using only open-source geospatial data
